title: Hub log
intro: What the hub recorded itself: restarts and their causes, updates, Wi-Fi, module poll failures, hours and days closing. The lines are technical — for an engineer or support; press “Copy” when contacting support.
failBoot: Failures recorded since the last start: {n}.
noPersist: The hub can't read its log files right now — only lines since the last start are shown.
error: The log didn't load: the hub isn't answering or its firmware doesn't keep a log.
